title: Ancient TETRAD System
author: Zane C.
desc:
Novice lifters this is a similar Ancient TETRAD training.
Day 1- focus on explosive training without fatigue 
Day 2- focus on heavy training full body 
Day 3- focus on stretching and recovery 
Day 4- focus on the pump and practice, or lagging body parts that need to be strengthened up. 
Add 1 extra day
 Day 5- Calisthenics move your body without fatigue This program is great for people with physical demanding jobs that helps the person train without burnout and being consistent with training ￼
